input.quote: (a) Appointment of Marketing Agent. The Issuer and the Servicer appoint Cellco to act as Marketing Agent for the Receivables. Cellco accepts the appointment and agrees to perform its obligations set forth in this Agreement.
input.rationale: No exclusivity, "sole supplier" or requirements-purchasing covenant binds us (the Issuer or the Depositor) anywhere in the agreement. The only "exclusive" references are (i) Section 9.10's notice of exclusive control over the Cap Collateral Account — a control right that runs in the Issuer's favour — and (ii) the nonexclusive jurisdiction clause in Section 10.6, neither of which is a restrictive covenant. Cellco's appointments as Servicer (Article III), Custodian (Section 3.10) and Marketing Agent (Section 3.11) are ordinary service appointments, not stated to be exclusive, and they do not restrict us from engaging other providers: Section 7.2 gives us Servicer Termination Events and Section 7.4 expressly contemplates appointment of a Successor Servicer (including an unaffiliated institution whose regular business includes servicing receivables). This meets the preferred position of no exclusivity obligation on the customer, so no redline is warranted.
